answer: Each AI juror posts a quartz‑signed stake to a jetty contract that records its current decision vector on the atlas ledger. When a new proposal is voted, the contract computes the median of all vectors; any juror whose output diverges beyond a calibrated threshold is automatically slashed, forfeiting its entire stake. An attacker must therefore lock 10 tokens per fake identity and endure a 48‑hour waiting period before the stake can be reclaimed, making mass Sybil creation prohibitively costly.
